name: muay-thai-cardio-rounds
why: His live chat, 19 Nov 2026, marked 7.5/10 by a CSCS review: after 'my cardio is so bad' the coach praised and prescribed; asked how to improve for Muay Thai it prescribed 10-15 minutes of skipping and offered a change in plain words with no buttons. A strength coach asks first about breathing and pacing (the commonest cause in combat sports), and the conditioning that transfers is 3-minute rounds with a minute's rest, named so the app's round timer can start it. Turn 0 carries no card.

contextOverrides.exercise_summary:
Monday: Lower body — Barbell Squats 4x6 @ 55kg, Romanian Deadlifts 3x8 @ 50kg, Bulgarian Split Squats 3x8 each side, Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise 3x12, Plank 3x40s. [CLOSED at 16 of 16 planned working sets]
Today (Wednesday): Upper body — Dumbbell Bench Press 4x8, Dumbbell Rows 4x10, Overhead Press 3x8, Hammer Curls 3x12.
Friday: Full body, the lighter one — Goblet Squats 3x10, Glute Bridge 3x12, Chest-Supported Row 3x10, Dead Bug 3x8.
Saturday: rest from the gym (five-a-side in the morning).
